meta.title: DailyRiffs
meta.description: Electric guitar from zero, by playing. Tuner, tabs with a click track and your rig dialed in.

home.title: Tune. Play. Repeat.
home.summary: Ten minutes a day with the guitar in your hands. The screen only tells you what to play.
home.note: Plug in the Strat and set the Frontman to Clean.

cards.title: Tune your Strat
cards.summary: Six strings, one at a time. Don't play until the center LED lights up.

cards.title: Riff 001
cards.summary: E minor power chords with palm mute. Start at 90 BPM.

cards.title: G–C–D changes
cards.summary: Strum quarters and change without stopping. Goal: 20 changes a minute.

cards.title: Your rig
cards.summary: Pickup selector, knobs and Frontman presets. How every song sounds.

tuner.title: Tuner
tuner.summary: Pick one open string and let it ring. Tighten the peg if the needle goes left, loosen it if it goes right.
tips: Always tune up to the note: if you overshoot, drop below and come back up. The string won't slip.
With the tremolo, every string pulls the others: go around twice.
Guitar volume on 10 and selector on 3 so the mic hears it clean.

deck.trainer: 4 clean loops and it goes up 5 BPM. A miss doesn't count.
deck.legend: h = hammer-on · p = pull-off · b = bend · r = release · / = slide · x = dead note

rep.title: Repertoire
rep.summary: What you've got to play. Paste your tab or chord chart and it stays on this device.
rep.empty: Nothing at this level. Paste a tab or clear the filter.

import.title: Paste your tab
import.summary: Your tab or chart is the source: it's stored as-is and played back exactly, with a click.
import.tab: Tablature · 6 lines per system, high e on top
import.chartPlaceholder:
[Verse] x2
| Am | C | G | D |
[Chorus]
| F . G . | Am |
import.needOne: Paste a tab or a chart, at least one.
import.aiOff: AI isn't connected on this server. Paste your tab.
import.aiNote: AI gives chords, structure and approximate riffs with a confidence level. Always check against the record.

song.notFound: That song isn't on this device.
song.soundNote: Starting point. Dial it in by ear.
song.compare: Check against the record. If something sounds off, fix your tab and save again.

gear.title: Your rig
gear.summary: This is what you've got plugged in. Songs set the selector and knobs for this rig.
gear.tip: Roll the Volume down before switching to O.D.: the gain jump makes everything louder at once.
